</script>
<script>
/* Mars + Moon submenus: Visit (lander apps bundled unchanged) + SpaceMind research prompts */
(function(){
 var ov=document.getElementById('aresOv'),back=document.getElementById('aresBack'),load=document.getElementById('aresLoad'),frame=null,url=null;
 var NAMES={mars:'Mars',moon:'the Moon',jupiter:'Jupiter'};
 function closeSide(){if(window.matchMedia&&window.matchMedia('(max-width:760px)').matches)document.body.classList.add('side-off');}
 function openLander(key){
  if(frame)return;
  var contextualSpaceMind=(key==='mars'||key==='moon');
  document.body.classList.toggle('lander-spacemind',contextualSpaceMind);
  var smInput=document.getElementById('smIn');
  if(smInput)smInput.placeholder=contextualSpaceMind?('Ask SpaceMind about '+(key==='moon'?'the Moon':'Mars')+' surface…'):'Ask about a planet or object';
  if(contextualSpaceMind){var worldName=key==='moon'?'Moon':'Mars';var overviewPrompt=key==='moon'?'Give me a scientific overview of the lunar surface, including regolith, maria, highlands, impact craters, polar regions, water ice and major landing sites.':'Give me a scientific overview of the Martian surface, including major terrain regions, Olympus Mons, Valles Marineris, craters, regolith, dust, water evidence and rover landing sites.';window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('planetx:body-selected',{detail:{name:worldName,prompt:overviewPrompt}}));}
  try{
   var bin=atob(document.getElementById('aresB64-'+key).textContent.trim()),bytes=new Uint8Array(bin.length);
   for(var i=0;i<bin.length;i++)bytes[i]=bin.charCodeAt(i);
   url=URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([bytes],{type:'text/html;charset=utf-8'}));
  }catch(e){load.style.display='grid';load.textContent='COULD NOT LOAD';console.error(e);return;}
  frame=document.createElement('iframe');
  frame.title=(key==='moon'?'Moon Base':(key==='jupiter'?'Mission Jupiter - Emergency Escape':'Ares Lander - Mars Mission'));
  frame.setAttribute('allow','autoplay; fullscreen; display-capture');
  frame.addEventListener('load',function(){load.style.display='none';try{frame.contentWindow.focus();}catch(e){}});
  load.style.display='grid';load.textContent='DESCENDING TO '+NAMES[key].toUpperCase()+'\u2026';
  frame.src=url;ov.insertBefore(frame,ov.firstChild);
  ov.classList.add('open');ov.setAttribute('aria-hidden','false');
  requestAnimationFrame(function(){requestAnimationFrame(function(){ov.classList.add('show');});});
  closeSide();
 }
 function closeLander(){
  document.body.classList.remove('lander-spacemind');
  var smPanel=document.getElementById('smPanel'),smButton=document.getElementById('smBtn');
  if(smPanel)smPanel.classList.remove('open');
  if(smButton)smButton.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');
  var smInput=document.getElementById('smIn');if(smInput)smInput.placeholder='Ask about a planet or object';
  ov.classList.remove('show');ov.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');
  setTimeout(function(){
   ov.classList.remove('open');
   if(frame){frame.remove();frame=null;}  /* frees the 3D context and stops audio */
   if(url){URL.revokeObjectURL(url);url=null;}
  },350);
 }
 Array.prototype.forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll('[data-lander]'),function(b){b.addEventListener('click',function(){openLander(b.getAttribute('data-lander'));});});
 back.addEventListener('click',closeLander);
 /* keep the opened Mars/Moon submenu in view (the Moon sits near the bottom of the list) */
 var nameEl=document.getElementById('name'),sideList=document.querySelector('#side .side-list');
 function revealSub(){
  setTimeout(function(){
   var cur=nameEl.textContent.trim(),id=cur==='Moon'?'moonSub':(cur==='Mars'?'marsSub':(cur==='Jupiter'?'jupiterSub':null));
   if(!id||!sideList)return;
   var sub=document.getElementById(id),btn=sub.previousElementSibling,bottom=sub.offsetTop+sub.offsetHeight;
   if(bottom>sideList.scrollTop+sideList.clientHeight)sideList.scrollTop=Math.max(0,Math.min(bottom-sideList.clientHeight+12,btn.offsetTop-40));
  },80);
 }
 if(nameEl)new MutationObserver(revealSub).observe(nameEl,{childList:true,characterData:true,subtree:true});
 document.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){if(e.key==='Escape'&&ov.classList.contains('open'))closeLander();});
 var Q={
  'mars:overview':'Give me a concise scientific overview of Mars: size, gravity, day length, orbit, composition and internal structure, with sources.',
  'mars:geology':'Explain the geology of Mars, including Olympus Mons, Valles Marineris, the Tharsis region and the crustal dichotomy, with key measurements and sources.',
  'mars:climate':'Describe the atmosphere and climate of Mars: composition, pressure, temperature range, dust storms and seasons, with sources.',
  'mars:missions':'Summarize key Mars missions and rovers (Viking, Pathfinder, Spirit, Opportunity, Curiosity, Perseverance, orbiters) and their main discoveries, with sources.',
  'mars:life':'Summarize current scientific evidence on past or present water on Mars and its habitability, including biosignature searches and open questions, with sources.',
  'moon:overview':'Give me a concise scientific overview of the Moon: size, gravity, orbit, tidal locking, composition and internal structure, with sources.',
  'moon:geology':'Explain the geology of the Moon: maria versus highlands, impact craters, regolith, the far side and the South Pole-Aitken basin, with key measurements and sources.',
  'moon:missions':'Summarize key lunar missions from Apollo through Chang\u2019e, Chandrayaan and Artemis, including their main scientific results and current plans, with sources.',
  'moon:ice':'Summarize the evidence for water ice in permanently shadowed lunar polar craters and the Moon\u2019s potential resources for a future base, with sources and open questions.',
  'moon:origin':'Explain how the Moon formed (the giant-impact hypothesis) and how the Moon and Earth interact, including tides and orbital evolution, with sources.'
 };
 Array.prototype.forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll('[data-q]'),function(b){
  b.addEventListener('click',function(){
   var k=b.getAttribute('data-q'),body=k.split(':')[0]==='moon'?'Moon':'Mars';
   window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('planetx:body-selected',{detail:{name:body,prompt:Q[k]}}));
   closeSide();
  });
 });
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
